source.title: Open problems on backward stochastic differential equations

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH document 1594452. Direct zbMATH web fetch returned a Cloudflare challenge/HTTP 403, so the zbMATH API was used only as resolver metadata. The API identified the exact work as Shige Peng, "Open problems on backward stochastic differential equations", DOI 10.1007/978-0-387-35359-3_32, pp. 265-273, and exposed no full-text links.

Bounded recovery checked the DOI/Springer chapter page, Crossref metadata, exact-title search results, and the Amanote metadata page. The Springer chapter page visible body was abstract/references/access metadata only and stated that access required institutional login; the Amanote page was also metadata/link-only. The direct Springer PDF endpoint could not be downloaded into the local workflow because local network/DNS resolution failed during download attempts. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered, so no questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, or snippets.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1594452.json and outputs/latest.json.
